title: Ongoing Processing
meta: A document and data flow that runs every day or week on its own, with alerts when it needs you. From $150, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Ongoing processing that runs without manual work
overview: Once reading, extracting and checking work well, the next step is to stop starting them by hand. We build the flow end to end, so new documents are picked up on a schedule or when they arrive, processed, checked and sent to your sheet or tool. You get a run history, error alerts and a handover guide. Monthly care after the starter sprint is quoted separately.

faq: How often can the flow run?
As often as every few minutes, or on a daily or weekly schedule. Most clients choose daily. We set the schedule with you based on volume and any limits of the tools involved.
What if something stops working after delivery?
The flow sends an alert when a run fails, so you hear about it. Fixes for problems caused by our build are covered in the revision period. Monthly care is quoted separately.
Do I need to keep a computer on?
No. We run the flow in a hosted automation tool in your own account, so it does not depend on your laptop. Hosting or tool subscriptions, if any, are billed to you directly.
Can this include steps from other Data and documents services?
Yes. Reading, extraction, cleaning, checks and spreadsheet delivery can be chained into one flow. Tell us which steps you want and we scope them together.
